name: Gross Margin
description: Calculate gross margin as a percentage of revenue.
business_contexts: a retailer assessing gross margin percentage on total sales
a manufacturer assessing gross margin percentage on a product line
an e-commerce brand assessing gross margin percentage after landed cost
a consumer goods company assessing gross margin percentage across a quarter
a distributor assessing gross margin percentage on a shipment
question_patterns: Given the revenue and cost of goods sold below, what is the gross margin percentage?
Calculate gross margin as a percentage of revenue from the figures given.
What percentage of revenue is gross profit, given the values below?
Calculate the gross margin percentage from the revenue and COGS shown.
Using the revenue and COGS given, what is the gross margin percentage?
solution_logic: Step 1: Calculate gross margin = (revenue − cogs) / revenue
key_insight: Gross margin is gross profit expressed as a percentage of revenue, so it stays comparable across businesses of very different sizes.
common_mistakes: Dividing by COGS instead of revenue
Reporting the gross profit dollar figure instead of converting it to a percentage
framework_soundbite: Gross margin is gross profit over revenue — the percentage that lets you compare businesses of different sizes.
